import sys

def main():
    # Read four integers from stdin
    a = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    b = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    c = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    d = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    # Compute intermediate and final results
    mult_result = a * b
    add_result = mult_result + c
    final_result = add_result // d
    
    # Print results in required format
    print(f"Intermediate result of a * b: {mult_result}")
    print(f"Intermediate result of a * b + c: {add_result}")
    print(f"Final result of (a * b + c) / d: {final_result}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
